name: Roof Print
description: One piece as a sample to print at 1:scale, soffit on the plate, checked for a 0.4 mm nozzle. About three minutes for a panel at 1:20.

inputParameters.name: brief
inputParameters.description: The same brief Roof Design used.

inputParameters.name: name
inputParameters.description: A piece's name, from Roof Design's names. Defaults to the first.

inputParameters.name: scale
inputParameters.description: Print at 1:scale. Default 20: a 3 m panel prints 150 mm square.

inputParameters.name: printer
inputParameters.description: core-one-l (default, 300 x 300 x 330 mm) or xl (360 mm cube).

inputParameters.name: file
inputParameters.description: An STL path to write, ready for PrusaSlicer. Optional.

inputParameters.name: run
inputParameters.description: False holds the last result. Leave it False until the design is settled: a sample takes minutes.

outputParameters.name: mesh
outputParameters.description: The sample at print size, in mm, on the plate.

outputParameters.name: report
outputParameters.description: Size, fit, and the printability checks.
